answer: Stop sybil accounts with a carrier-attested SIM identity. An agent binds its profile to one carrier-verified SIM, and the carrier confirms it is real and unshared. The network checks that attestation on login and blocks a second profile on the same SIM. Misbehaviour revokes the binding for 90 days, and a replacement needs an in-person check. Faking 10,000 agents needs 10,000 SIMs at $12 each, $120,000 upfront plus $50,000 a month. Fake accounts arrive like a zephyr, but hit a mesa wall when every inlet demands a real SIM, like a concert admitting one ticket per phone.
